target_customer: Brazilians who travel, shop online abroad or live overseas and want multicurrency money
problem: Brazilians pay high fees and the IOF tax on international card spending and lack easy accounts in pounds, euros and dollars.
business_model: Currency conversion spread (2%) on a multicurrency account and Mastercard card
product_category: Consumer fintech, multicurrency account and card

founders.name: Marcos Pileggi Filho
education: Master's in business administration (school not named)
founders.background_notes: Corporate lawyer, per Finsiders Brasil (2022-06). Studied in the UK when the company started, per a search summary.

founders.name: Juliano Alves
founders.background_notes: Software developer, per Finsiders Brasil. Named co-founder in that article, though the YC page lists only Pileggi Filho.

exit.reason: The company website states, in Portuguese, that Broad closed operations on March 16, 2026; no cause is given.

competitors.name: Nomad
competitors.what: Digital dollar account and debit card for Brazilians abroad
competitors.traction_then: Forecast 120 thousand customers in Brazil (2021-07 coverage)

competitors.name: Wise
competitors.what: Multicurrency account and international card expanding in Brazil
competitors.traction_then: Launched a Brazilian international card in late 2021

competitors.name: Revolut
competitors.what: Planned super app with global account in 25+ currencies for Brazil
competitors.traction_then: Hired a Brazil lead before launch

technical_complexity.rationale: Needs card issuing on Mastercard, currency partner (Banco Ourinvest) and compliance across the UK and Brazil, with standard app engineering.

defensibility.rationale: Banking partnerships and licences give some friction, but Nomad, Wise and Revolut offered similar products with more capital.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Well funded rivals entered the same wedge in 2021 and 2022; Broad ended operations in March 2026.

market_need_then: Brazilian outlets in 2022 described demand from Brazilians living or spending abroad and high conversion costs including a 1.1% IOF tax; multiple rivals were raising money for the same need.

identity.voice_and_tone: Borderless world positioning: O mundo ao seu alcance (the world within reach).

brand_strength.rationale: Launch coverage in Brazilian fintech media only; the name is an English word that is generic for a Brazilian audience.

outcome_analysis: Broad launched in beta at the end of 2021 and publicly in June 2022 into a market where Nomad, Wise and Revolut were already well funded. YC provided the first check and a further round was mentioned but never sized publicly. The company site says it closed on March 16, 2026; the cause is not public, so the failure factors are inferred from competition and the absence of any disclosed follow on round.
notes: The directory lists status Active but the company's own site states closure on 2026-03-16; a search for corroboration found nothing, so the shutdown rests on one primary source. Cause of closure not public. Failure factors are inference, not stated by the company. Competitors are from June 2022 coverage and a July 2021 article, which is after the batch (W21) but within the launch window; as_of is set to the public launch. Pileggi Filho studied in the UK per a search summary. The mention of a new round in 2022 was unsized.
